name: citywide-key-mgmt
description: City Wide Boston Key Management System — web + offline Windows desktop

scripts.build:frontend:desktop: VITE_DESKTOP=1 VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm --prefix frontend run build -- --base=./
scripts.build:desktop: npm --prefix desktop run icon && npm --prefix desktop run build:ts
scripts.ensure:seed: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('backend/database/citywide.db')){console.log('seed db present')}else{console.log('seeding template db...');require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix backend run seed',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.desktop:build:all: npm run ensure:seed && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend:desktop && npm run build:desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build:all && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:build:all && npm --prefix desktop run pack
